messages:
liam: CI microbench failed on PR #5389 — kv_cache hit-rate test regressed ~12% vs baseline. Job: perf/microbench/kv-hitrate. Anyone seen this?

maya: yep reproduced in the CI artifact. Failure looks consistent across runs. Heap of traces point at a change in the kernel selector heuristics from that PR.

dev-ci-bot: [artifact] perf/microbench/kv-hitrate — stdout attached: https://ci.internal/redwood/5389/artifacts/kv-hit.log :warning:

liam: main suspect commit from the PR is 1a2b3c4 (kernel-selector: prefer-v2-for-short-seq). Bisect started locally.

sam: ran a quick bisect on my machine, landing point is 1a2b3c4 -> revert of that line drops p95 tokens/ms back to baseline. Looks like the selector picks v2 which disables prefix-aware KV batching.

nora: can someone paste the microbench command? I'll run it under perf with flamegraph.

maya: run: `./scripts/run_microbench --suite kv_hit_rate --iters 1000 --batch-size 8`

liam: local microbench snippet after failing commit:```text
kv_hit_rate: baseline=0.121 hits/sec
after 1a2b3c4=0.106 hits/sec (-12.4%)
hot path: kernel_selector::choose_kernel -> dispatch_v2 (20%)
kv cache ops increased stall_ms by ~4.1ms
```

maya: quick perf top shows increased cycles in `dispatch_v2::handle_prefetch` and `kv::eviction::maybe_run` (surprising). Possibly tighter interop between new kernel path and KV eviction heuristics.

sam: workaround: force legacy kernel for short seqs via env var `REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE=legacy_short` to confirm — that restores numbers. Can we gate that behind a rollout flag?

ops-bot: Rollout flags: feature/kernel-selector-v2 = enabled (50% canary).

liam: that explains the CI regression on the canary path. PR landed without keeping the gate. I'm going to draft a rollback PR to revert the selector tweak and re-enable controlled rollout.

sam: I can prepare a minimal revert PR (5401) and a follow-up that reintroduces the change behind a flag + tests.

nora: once revert queued, I'll run perf flamegraphs and check KV eviction interaction. If original change disabled a cache-friendly path, we need to add unit tests for `kv_batcher` hit-rate.

maya: also adding a microperf unit test for `kernel_selector` that asserts we don't regress the `kv_hit_rate` baseline in CI would help.

liam: thanks — opening revert now. @sam please add the canary gating in the follow-up. :thumbsup:

dev-ci-bot: PR 5401 opened by liam: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/5401 — CI jobs queued.

liam: tracking: will monitor perf CI, and if green we'll merge revert and schedule a proper rollout with metrics.

maya: noted. I'll follow up with a short postmortem once we have the flamegraphs.

sam: if anyone hits this locally and wants a quick patch:```diff
- if (prefer_v2(short_seq)) { use_v2(); }
+ if (feature_flag_enabled("kernel-selector-v2") && prefer_v2(short_seq)) { use_v2(); }
```

liam: great — thanks everyone.
